name: Imouto 4nin to Nakadashi Seikatsu! ~Jare Tsuki Amae ni Osewa♪ Imouto-tachi to Ichaicha ga Tomaranai! Onii-chan no Seishi wa Zetsumetsu Hisshi!?~
original_name: 妹4人と中出し性活！～じゃれつき甘えにお世話♪妹たちとイチャイチャがとまらない！お兄ちゃんの精子は絶滅必至!?～
source:
Big brother lives a harem life of babymaking sweet *luurrrrv* with four adoring imoutos!

Welcome to the countryside, where a protagonist returns to the house he grew up in to find his little sisters have done some growing up of their own. Which one will become oniichan's bride? They're all competing for your affection and throw themselves at you, wombs fertile, in a soft girlie attack. Kick back and enjoy the dewey sweet slow life with your harem of, at home, around town and at the local festival. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102416.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
哥哥与四名深爱自己的妹妹们，过着甜蜜的造人后宫生活！

欢迎来到乡下。主人公回到自己长大的老家，却发现妹妹们也已经长大成人。究竟谁会成为哥哥的新娘？她们争相索取你的爱，子宫饥渴地扑向你。

放松下来，与后宫妹妹们一起享受甜美缓慢的生活：在家中、镇上，以及当地的祭典，到处都能留下回忆。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102416.html]DLsite English[/url]]
